name: Digivated Membership
custom_summary: Unlimited launches that go live instantly, plus the full UI/UX Prompt Packet and every member guide. $5 once.
description:
Launch as much as you want.

Membership is $5, paid once. It's not a subscription and nothing renews.

What you get

  • Unlimited project uploads. Each one goes live the moment you publish. No review queue, no badge needed.
  • The full UI/UX Prompt Packet. All 75 prompts, the prompt builder, workflows and checklists.
  • Every member guide, including the member-only carousel library.

How to use it

Buy with the email you use on Digivated. Then open https://digivated.com/new-launch and press “I’ve paid, check again”. Your account switches to unlimited right away.

Want the Prompt Packet on another browser? Verify at https://digivated.com/membership#member-sign-in with your receipt email or license key.

News and your first launch stay free for everyone. Projects still follow the listing rules, and traffic or sales aren't guaranteed.
